paper_title: 基于目标检测的高速公路应急车道实时启用策略研究

argumentation_roles.lesson: Show detection/tracking examples together with calibrated line/ROI geometry and a unit registry. A trend plot against screenshots verifies face plausibility, not detector/counting accuracy.
Use comparable scatter+fit panels and a metric table, but unit-close q/rho/u first and flag when point-detector definitions violate the continuous q=rho*u identity.
Plot chronological lead forecasts with an explicit 10-minute shift, holdout boundary and event-level alarms; lag correlation/feature importance belongs before, not instead of, true future holdout.
Plot K(t) with open/close hysteresis bands and separately replay inflow/outflow contributions. Calibrate Qmax/thresholds independently to avoid circular validation.
If opening capacity is modeled by a multiplier, show a sensitivity fan across plausible multipliers and label it scenario analysis rather than measured effect.
Draw the observation dependency graph before/after moving a camera. Any state feature lost by relocation must be redefined and revalidated before the controller is claimed operational.
